title: [Not-Solved] Random freeze and missing journalctl
body: Hello Since a few days I have random freeze happening without noticeable reason. When system freeze I have no choice but do a hard reset. It can crash even when I'm not using the computer waiting on the session lock screen I've tried to troubleshoot the issue by inspecting journalctl but it looks like the journal logs are missing. ie. if the system crashed at 16:24, the last lines in the logs may be at 16:11 (just an example) Here the latest log I got from `journalctl -b-1` Mar 23 16:04:40 kepler kernel: Linux version
